contract.instructions: Prerequisites (plan §7.2 exact table): DB, A1 (A1 owns semantic-search-candidate-trace.ts parser; B1 consumes the A1 trace contract). RED test (§7.6): vector-candidate-fusion.ranking-v3.test.ts — trace_records_raw_arm_and_core_fusion_ranks_without_product_change; expected failure before implementation: new trace fields are absent or product output changes; minimal passing behavior: fields are present and product output remains equal. The focused command targets future test files that DO NOT exist at base (verified) — unverifiable-at-base; do not run until the implementation round. affected_command pnpm --filter @zokizuan/satori-core test is repo-verified (packages/core/package.json test script globs src/**/*.test.ts). Existing vector-candidate-fusion.test.ts asserts VECTOR_CANDIDATE_RRF_K_V1 === 100 and must keep passing.
